The [[Sathari/Legends|Sathari]] [[Pathran Helshar]] founded a '''resistance''' movement against [[Gel Marcolf]], a tyrant who ruled the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Quolas]]. Initially, the resistance did not take action for fear of retribution against Helshar's family and other townsfolk.<ref name="CotG" />
